UserPublicProfile.title: UserPublicProfile
UserPublicProfile.description: Public workspace profile for a Google-authenticated ScapRecord creator without PII.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Creator display name from Google Account.

driveFolder.description: Default Google Drive sync folder path.

driveConnected.description: Whether the user has connected their Google Drive with drive.file scope.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII document storing the user's verified Google email address.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the parent user document.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the private record was last updated.

RecordingDocument.title: RecordingDocument
RecordingDocument.description: Metadata and Google Drive sharing link for a Loom-style screen or camera recording.

id.description: Recording identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the recording creator.

ownerName.description: Display name of the recording creator.

durationSec.description: Duration of the recording in seconds.

captureMode.description: Capture mode used for the recording.

driveSynced.description: Whether the video file is synced to the user's Google Drive.

driveFileId.description: Google Drive file ID for sharing.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the recording metadata was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the recording metadata was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Public creator profiles storing display name and Google Drive folder preference.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Owner-only PII subcollection storing the user's verified Google email.

/recordings/{recordingId}.description: Loom-style video recording metadata and Google Drive sharing links.
